title: Belly Dance Classes | Tribal Fusion Beginners | Dance Choreography | For A Slimmer Fitter Body

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor provides detailed breakdown of movements with visual analogies and repetition. She encourages students to practice both sides while maintaining correct posture.

lesson_structure.note: Welcomes viewers and introduces the tribal fusion choreography.
Breaks down horizontal chest circles and ribcage slides.
Teaches ribcage forward and back movements.
Teaches horizontal chest circles combined with leg shifts.
Teaches hip and shoulder isolation lifts and drops.

cues: Keep the space in the grace
metaphors: Standing in the middle of a clock
Imagine if you have pens on your chest pointing at the floor
Drawing the number 11 on the floor
Drawing a circle on the screen
common_mistakes: Weight in the wrong part of the foot
safety: Bend knees and engage tummy to protect the body
Keep your neck long and avoid slouching

steps_taught.name: Ribcage slides
steps_taught.description: Shifting ribs side to side with optional heel rises.

steps_taught.name: Ribcage forward and back
steps_taught.description: Moving chest forward and back with weight on heels and toes.

steps_taught.name: Vertical chest circles
steps_taught.description: Drawing vertical circles with the chest from side to side.

steps_taught.name: Hip and shoulder isolation
steps_taught.description: Lifting and dropping hips and shoulders together in classical position.

what_works: Clear visual analogies like clocks and pens
Step-by-step breakdown from slow to full speed
Constant reminders of posture and weight distribution
what_hinders: Rapid transitions between complex terminology and movement

quotes.text: Bend those knees, tummy engaged, chest lifted, shoulders down.
Imagine if you were standing in the middle of a clock.
Imagine if you have pens on your chest pointing at the floor.
No squashed heads, no squashed heads! Long neck.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates horizontal chest circles with bent knees and weight shifting.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact muscular engagement in the lower back

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher uses hand gestures to explain forward and backward ribcage movement.

extraction.distinctive_method: Using imaginary props like pens attached to the chest or drawing numbers on the floor to visualize body paths.
